data.title: Vehicle Tax Assessment (Kraftfahrzeugsteuerbescheid) – 186,00 € per year from 2025
data.summary: The Hauptzollamt Musterhafen sets the vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for the vehicle with registration number MH-BK 510 at 186.00 € per year, effective 01.01.2025, to be collected annually in advance by direct debit (Lastschrift).
data.explanation: This is a tax assessment notice (Bescheid) setting your annual vehicle tax at 186.00 €, starting 01.01.2025. The amount will be collected automatically each year via direct debit, so no action is needed for payment as long as your account has sufficient funds. If you believe the assessment is wrong, you can file an objection (Einspruch) with the issuing authority, in writing or electronically, by the deadline shown (one month after you are considered to have received this letter). If you miss it, the assessment becomes final. Consider consulting a tax advisor if you're unsure about your case.
